outcome: The player went through with the wedding ceremony and married Kaidan at Dragonsreach.
citation: s10 obj: "Attend your wedding" (tier B; s1 obj "Take Kaidan, Vilkas and Farkas to speak to Balgruuf") -- RUNTIME-VERIFY that the ceremony completes on this stage.

outcome: Kaidan took the path of vengeance and killed Wulf, reclaiming Kodlak's hammer for the Companions.
citation: s120: "Kaidan has gotten justice for the Companions by slaying Kodlak's murderer and reclaiming the former Harbinger's hammer."
branch_note: Vengeance branch of the s110 kill-or-spare choice; mutually exclusive with s121.

outcome: Kaidan took the path of mercy and spared Wulf, who then died of his wounds and left the hammer behind.
citation: s121: "Kodlak's murderer succumbed to his injuries, enabling Kaidan to reclaim the hammer the man had refused to surrender."
branch_note: Mercy branch of the s110 kill-or-spare choice; mutually exclusive with s120.

outcome: The newlyweds reached Northwind Summit and settled in for their honeymoon together.
citation: s120: "We finally met up with Kaidan and he took me back to Northwind Summit. We can stay here as long as we want for a honeymoon."
branch_note: Same arc as s150; the honeymoon begins here.

outcome: The player saw the honeymoon through with their spouse before returning to the road.
citation: s150 [COMPLETE]: "We finally met up with Kaidan and he took me back to Northwind Summit for a honeymoon."
branch_note: Terminal of the honeymoon arc; single outcome.

outcome: The player hunted down and killed the dragon at Rift Watchtower as the price of Kaidan's release.
citation: s70: "The dragon is now dead and I should take to bones and scales to Lillith."
branch_note: Single outcome; the kill is Maven's price rather than a free choice.

outcome: The player got Kaidan out of Riften's jail after brokering his release through Brynjolf and Maven.
citation: s100: "I've now freed Kaidan but I should wait for a little while and see if he wants to talk about what happened."
branch_note: Single outcome; the release was bought through Maven's corrupt bargain.

outcome: The player committed Kaidan to joining the Dark Brotherhood and told Astrid so.
citation: s30 obj: "Tell Astrid that Kaidan will join the Dark Brotherhood" (tier B, no journal text; terminal s80 inferred) -- RUNTIME-VERIFY that this stage fires on the pledge to Astrid.
branch_note: Single outcome; Sithis and the Night Mother are not Daedric Princes, so no namespaced tag applies.

outcome: The player refused to be pushed away and swore to stand as Kaidan's shield through his collapse.
citation: s41: "He is my shield and it is about time he learned that I will be his as well whether he likes it or not."
branch_note: Single outcome; the payoff of the repeated refusals to abandon him.

outcome: Rosalind was killed and Kaidan was freed from the nightmares her cult had inflicted on him.
citation: s50 [COMPLETE]: "Rosalind is dead. Mehrunes Dagon seems satisfied, at least for now."
branch_note: Single outcome; Dagon is only 'satisfied' so no namespaced Daedric tag is asserted.

outcome: The player drew Kaidan out of Rosalind's self-loathing and he chose to fight for their future.
citation: s25: "He finally seems to realize that it isn't enough to just leave his past behind. He has to want to fight for his future... and he's ready to try."

outcome: Both spoke their hearts plainly and committed to a shared future together.
citation: s40: "We both took a leap of faith and spoke our hearts. No more being afraid or letting doubt and what if's determine what happens between us."

outcome: Kaidan let go of his guilt over the cult and the two bound themselves to one another for good.
citation: s80 [COMPLETE]: "he now accepts that I will always stand beside him... I am his and he is mine."
branch_note: Terminal of the reconciliation arc; single outcome.

outcome: The player kept a three-favour bargain with Karisiff and secured her a paying post as the Ragged Flagon's bard.
citation: s110 [COMPLETE]: "I completed three favors for her... collected bear claws, retrieved Petunia her lute, and arranged for her to have a job as The Ragged Flagon's bard."
branch_note: Single outcome; the fetch legs themselves are not judged.
